binaryOverlapPair.selectionRule: Among all commit pairs with nonzero prior overlap, minimize absolute overlap-fraction difference; ties resolve by commit order.

currentMaskLayerRelationship.definition: Jaccard overlap between actual new Plate binary masks, paired with total-variation distance between their pre-commit exact layer-count distributions; all commit pairs included.

maximumMaskJaccardPair.selectionRule: Maximum binary-mask Jaccard across all unordered commit pairs; ties resolve by commit order.

exactCurrentContextMatches.definition: Exact same 96-grid cell, raw pheromone sample, Plate chemical memory, SurfaceField scalar, support sample, retained local foot load, and prior-overlap=true.

interpretationBoundary.qualifier: Observed as separately retained event-specific stack history beyond binary overlap in this deterministic 36-commit run. Current scalar and whole-mask geometry independence is not established; no Plate body/material law is validated.
